categories.name: Affiliate License-Licensee
categories.definition: Does the contract contain a license grant to a licensee (incl. sublicensor) and the affiliates of such licensee/sublicensor?

categories.name: Affiliate License-Licensor
categories.definition: Does the contract contain a license grant by affiliates of the licensor or that includes intellectual property of affiliates of the licensor?

categories.name: Agreement Date
categories.definition: The date of the contract

categories.name: Anti-Assignment
categories.definition: Is consent or notice required of a party if the contract is assigned to a third party?

categories.name: Audit Rights
categories.definition: Does a party have the right to  audit the books, records, or physical locations of the counterparty to ensure compliance with the contract?

categories.name: Cap On Liability
categories.definition: Does the contract include a cap on liability upon the breach of a party’s obligation? This includes time limitation for the counterparty to bring claims or maximum amount for recovery.

categories.name: Change Of Control
categories.definition: Does one party have the right to terminate or is consent or notice required of the counterparty if such party undergoes a change of control, such as a merger, stock sale, transfer of all or substantially all of its assets or business, or assignment by operation of law?

categories.name: Competitive Restriction Exception
categories.definition: This category includes the exceptions or carveouts to Non-Compete, Exclusivity and No-Solicit of Customers above.

categories.name: Covenant Not To Sue
categories.definition: Is a party restricted from contesting the validity of the counterparty’s ownership of intellectual property or otherwise bringing a claim against the counterparty for matters unrelated to the contract?

categories.name: Document Name
categories.definition: The name of the contract

categories.name: Effective Date
categories.definition: The date when the contract is effective

categories.name: Exclusivity
categories.definition: Is there an exclusive dealing  commitment with the counterparty? This includes a commitment to procure all “requirements” from one party of certain technology, goods, or services or a prohibition on licensing or selling technology, goods or services to third parties, or a prohibition on  collaborating or working with other parties), whether during the contract or  after the contract ends (or both).

categories.name: Expiration Date
categories.definition: On what date will the contract's initial term expire?

categories.name: Governing Law
categories.definition: Which state/country's law governs the interpretation of the contract?

categories.name: Insurance
categories.definition: Is there a requirement for insurance that must be maintained by one party for the benefit of the counterparty?

categories.name: Ip Ownership Assignment
categories.definition: Does intellectual property created  by one party become the property of the counterparty, either per the terms of the contract or upon the occurrence of certain events?

categories.name: Irrevocable Or Perpetual License
categories.definition: Does the contract contain a  license grant that is irrevocable or perpetual?

categories.name: Joint Ip Ownership
categories.definition: Is there any clause providing for joint or shared ownership of intellectual property between the parties to the contract?

categories.name: License Grant
categories.definition: Does the contract contain a license granted by one party to its counterparty?

categories.name: Liquidated Damages
categories.definition: Does the contract contain a clause that would award either party liquidated damages for breach or a fee upon the termination of a contract (termination fee)?

categories.name: Minimum Commitment
categories.definition: Is there a minimum order size or minimum amount or units per-time period that one party must buy from the counterparty under the contract?

categories.name: Most Favored Nation
categories.definition: Is there a clause that if a third party gets better terms on the licensing or sale of technology/goods/services described in the contract, the buyer of such technology/goods/services under the contract shall be entitled to those better terms?

categories.name: Non-Compete
categories.definition: Is there a restriction on the ability of a party to compete with the counterparty or operate in a certain geography or business or technology sector?

categories.name: Non-Disparagement
categories.definition: Is there a requirement on a party not to disparage the counterparty?

categories.name: Non-Transferable License
categories.definition: Does the contract limit the ability of a party to transfer the license being granted to a third party?

categories.name: No-Solicit Of Customers
categories.definition: Is a party restricted from contracting or soliciting customers or partners of the counterparty, whether during the contract or after the contract ends (or both)?

categories.name: No-Solicit Of Employees
categories.definition: Is there a restriction on a party’s soliciting or hiring employees and/or contractors from the  counterparty, whether during the contract or after the contract ends (or both)?

categories.name: Notice Period To Terminate Renewal
categories.definition: What is the notice period required to terminate renewal?

categories.name: Parties
categories.definition: The two or more parties who signed the contract

categories.name: Post-Termination Services
categories.definition: Is a party subject to obligations after the termination or expiration of a contract, including any post-termination transition, payment, transfer of IP, wind-down, last-buy, or similar commitments?

categories.name: Price Restrictions
categories.definition: Is there a restriction on the  ability of a party to raise or reduce prices of technology, goods, or  services provided?

categories.name: Renewal Term
categories.definition: What is the renewal term after the initial term expires? This includes automatic extensions and unilateral extensions with prior notice.

categories.name: Revenue/Profit Sharing
categories.definition: Is one party required to share revenue or profit with the counterparty for any technology, goods, or services?

categories.name: Rofr/Rofo/Rofn
categories.definition: Is there a clause granting one party a right of first refusal, right of first offer or right of first negotiation to purchase, license, market, or distribute equity interest, technology, assets, products or services?

categories.name: Source Code Escrow
categories.definition: Is one party required to deposit its source code into escrow with a third party, which can be released to the counterparty upon the occurrence of certain events (bankruptcy,  insolvency, etc.)?

categories.name: Termination For Convenience
categories.definition: Can a party terminate this  contract without cause (solely by giving a notice and allowing a waiting  period to expire)?

categories.name: Third Party Beneficiary
categories.definition: Is there a non-contracting party who is a beneficiary to some or all of the clauses in the contract and therefore can enforce its rights against a contracting party?

categories.name: Uncapped Liability
categories.definition: Is a party’s liability uncapped upon the breach of its obligation in the contract? This also includes uncap liability for a particular type of breach such as IP infringement or breach of confidentiality obligation.

categories.name: Unlimited/All-You-Can-Eat-License
categories.definition: Is there a clause granting one party an “enterprise,” “all you can eat” or unlimited usage license?

categories.name: Volume Restriction
categories.definition: Is there a fee increase or consent requirement, etc. if one party’s use of the product/services exceeds certain threshold?

categories.name: Warranty Duration
categories.definition: What is the duration of any  warranty against defects or errors in technology, products, or services  provided under the contract?
